title: Damage/Blast Damage
summary: Blast damage and knockdown / stagger status.
extract:
Blast Damage is one of the six secondary elemental damage types, composed of  Heat and  Cold elements. Deals increased damage to Infested Deimos, but reduced on Corpus Amalgam. Its status effect causes enemies to detonate an area of effect.

Status Effects

General
The status effect of  Blast damage is Detonate, which has a single-target portion and an AoE portion:
Single Target Damage: 1.5s after inflicting blast status on an enemy, the blast stack will detonate, dealing 30% weapon base damage to the target. Each blast stack has its own 1.5s fuse time before detonation. However, reaching 10 blast stacks will cause all stacks to detonate early, dealing 10 hits of 30% base damage to the target at once, for a total of 300% base damage.
AoE Damage: Upon reaching 10 blast stacks OR the target dying, all current stacks will be detonated early and cause a single 5m AoE explosion, dealing 300% weapon base damage per stack (max 3000%) to surrounding enemies. The initial target of the blast procs is not dealt this AoE damage, only the single target damage explained above. The blast radius is unaffected by  Firestorm or  Fulmination.
Enemies affected by a  Blast proc will have a small jet of sparks (like those from a firework) appear where the attack impacted.

Status Damage
Upon expiring normally, each proc deals  Blast damage equal to:
Modded Base Damage=Base Damage×(1+Base Damage Bonuses)×(1+Faction Damage Bonuses)

Notice that modded base damage calculation used for proc damage is not the same as normal damage calculations, ignoring physical and elemental damage bonuses.
Blast Proc Damage=0.3×Modded Base Damage×(1+Faction Damage Bonuses)×(1+Status Damage Bonuses)×Additional Multipliers
Upon expiring early, either by reaching maximum stacks or by killing the target, each proc will also deal  Blast damage in a 5m radius:
Radial Damage=3×Modded Base Damage×(1+Faction Damage Bonuses)×(1+Status Damage Bonuses)×Additional Multipliers

 Valence Formation or  Thermal Transfer does not increase  Blast status damage
Additional Multipliers include modded critical multiplier on Critical Hit and multipliers on Enemy Body Parts; these stack multiplicatively with each other.
The radial damage of all procs will be combined into one damage instance. This radial damage does not affect the initial target, which will only take the normal expiration damage of all procs.

Notes
Blast procs only deal 30% base damage per stack to their initial target, making blast significantly weaker for single target damage than any other damaging status effect. Instead, blast excels at dealing AoE damage, but only if the weapon is capable of getting a kill or reaching 10 blast stacks within the short 1.5s fuse time.
The 5m AoE damage has no falloff. The blast radius is unaffected by  Firestorm or  Fulmination.
Each blast stack has its own 1.5s duration, or "fuse," which is affected by Status Duration. Unlike other forms of Status Damage,  Detonate will always deal damage even if total Status Duration is below 0%.
Killing blows that inflict at least 1  Blast proc will still activate the full 5 meter, 300% damage explosion, even if the enemy had no blast stacks on them before the killing blow. Likewise, the killing blow does not need to proc blast so long as the enemy already has any blast stacks on them before they are killed.
Like other damaging statuses, Faction Damage Bonuses apply twice to Blast procs, making it a very powerful damage multiplier.
Unlike other damaging statuses, adding more elemental damage ( Heat and  Cold) will not increase the Blast proc damage. However  Heat and  Cold mods can still increase the chance that a status proc will be a Blast proc.
Damage multipliers from weakpoint hits, critical hits, and even "Headcrits" are all applied to Blast proc single target and AoE damage.
The AoE damage from 10-stack and on-kill detonations will also account for these damage multipliers, summing up the total damage from each individual blast stack. This makes critical headshot kills with a blast weapon incredibly strong for crowd clearing, due to their ability to apply the critical headshot multiplier in an AoE.
Interaction with  Xata's Whisper:
When an enemy is afflicted with one or more  Blast stacks, Xata's whisper will trigger off the detonation(s). Additionally, the Faction Damage Bonus will be applied again (effectively triple-dipping), and Elemental Bonuses will apply to Xata's Whisper damage (despite  Blast not being affected by Elemental Damage Bonuses).
Consider the following example: A gun deals 100 damage per bullet, and we have  Thermite Rounds,  Rime Rounds,  Stormbringer,  Primed Bane of Grineer, and Xata's whisper at base strength: The initial hit will deal 100 × (1 + 0.6 + 0.6 + 0.9) × (1 + 0.55) = 480.5 damage, and Xata's whisper will deal 0.26 × 480.5 × (1 + 0.55) = 193.6415 damage (the Faction Damage Bonus is applied again). If the hit proc'd  Blast, then the detonation damage will be 0.3 × 100 × (1 + 0.55)^2 = 72.075 (Elemental Damage doesn't apply to  Blast detonations and the  Faction Damage Bonus is applied again). Then, Xata's whisper will trigger off said detonation, dealing 0.26 × 72.075 × (1 + 0.55) × (1 + 0.6 + 0.6 + 0.9) = 90.0433 damage (as you can see, the Faction Damage Bonus is applied yet again, and the Elemental Damage Bonus is applied even though  Blast detonations don't scale off Elemental Damage Bonuses.

Railjack
 Blast does not have a Railjack space counterpart and is thus not able to proc any status effect nor is it included in calculations for status proc weighting.

Additional Effects
Some mods add additional effects when a  Blast occurs or for dealing  Blast damage.

Notes
Enemies killed while under the effect of a Blast proc will vaporize, making the body unable to be used by  Desecrate and will cause  Magnetize to stop pulling in more enemies.

Trivia
The  Blast property of the mixture of  Cold and  Heat is likely a reference to the thermite ice bomb; where thermite can burn so hot that it will melt the ice, boil the water, and ultimately decompose the vapor into hydrogen and oxygen. This in turn fuels the fire and cues the explosive property.
It could also be thermal shock, a fracturing that happens when cold items are rapidly heated or hot things are rapidly cooled. On the molecular level, solid objects expand when heated and contract when cooled, and if subject to a huge temperature change in a short period of time, many materials break down from the energetic motion. This phenomenon commonly occurs (violently) when rinsing a hot glass in a cold sink.
